entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer that manages multi-level states for users, sessions, and agents. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud SDK.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: A high-performance memory engine featuring sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication for efficient prompt caching. It utilizes a custom vector graph engine and automated fact extraction to maintain user profiles across connectors like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This AGPL-3.0 context database organizes agent memory into a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier hierarchical loading structure. It provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging and has demonstrated significant token reduction and task-completion gains in benchmarks.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated agent brain that extracts typed entity relationships without LLM calls and synthesizes prose answers with explicit gap analysis. It supports local deployment via PGLite and provides multi-user scoped access for secure memory management.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A learning-focused memory system that implements specific retain, recall, and reflect workflows for long-term agent intelligence. It integrates into existing agent architectures via an LLM wrapper and provides native SDKs for both Python and Node.js.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A foundational library for building stateful agents that provides a FastAPI server for managed or self-hosted memory operations. It enables hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection through dedicated Python and TypeScript client SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This provider manages context as a git-like repository, offering version control features such as branching and merging for markdown context trees. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system with sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI for manual memory management.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system designed for sub-millisecond performance using a single SQLite database. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) via stdio or SSE, allowing for direct memory operations through a Python SDK.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory architecture that combines vector search on Qdrant with structured facts and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context and runs on local infrastructure via Docker.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness designed to help agents succeed on complex tasks by generating filesystem-based traces and playbooks. It is compatible with Anthropic, OpenAI, and local models via Python and TypeScript CLI surfaces.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based engine to ensure no messages are lost during agent interactions. It stores metadata in SQLite with full-text search and builds depth-aware summary nodes for expanding compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for the Honcho library that enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agents. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker and PostgreSQL, supporting any OpenAI-compatible provider or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that ensures portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It imports data from sources like GitHub and Discord, achieving a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store human-readable context on a local disk. It enables multi-agent systems to share context across tools without requiring cloud API calls.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs a hybrid retrieval system combining BM25 and vector search to serve agents via MCP and specialized hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes LLM inference by using block reordering and deduplication to reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3×. It offers native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem, saving up to 36% in token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based long-term memory system uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every recalled memory. It features a self-directing loop for identifying knowledge gaps and supports an in-process embedded mode by default.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes. It manages state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for agent queries.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server designed for automated configuration with major coding agent clients.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory using semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and uses edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It renders these facts into files like AGENTS.md and pairs with Perseus Vault for encrypted semantic recall.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn enables cross-project memory by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache for coding agents.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces Hermes Agent tool-schema overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant keywords. It includes a dashboard to track token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes an embedded .lbdb graph database to surface high-priority memories through a 1-10 importance ranking system. It prioritizes BM25 keyword search and supports named graph relationships between entries to refine context prefetching.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Designed as a pull-model episodic memory provider, this plugin features an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking all prefetch operations. It distinguishes itself by supporting immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox, offering tools for searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server allows Hermes agents to manage payments using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It facilitates autonomous financial transactions by letting APIs charge for services and agents pay for them directly.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin focuses on local capability indexing by routing questions to whole artifacts instead of using traditional chunk-based RAG. It registers five native tools for knowledge retrieval and supports optional automated tool-routing notes generated via model calls.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and targeted searching. It enhances retrieval accuracy through configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This memory provider emphasizes security with default AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes. It utilizes HNSW ANN, sparse retrieval, and MinHash deduplication to manage long-term agent data.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: Operating locally over localhost, this plugin provides private code memory for repositories through semantic and literal search. It enables grounded Q&A by providing specific file-and-line citations for its responses.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider features 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also includes automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements subagent-driven development to enable autonomous task execution for Hermes Agent. It enforces technical rigor through red-green-refactor TDD and YAGNI principles while integrating with coding harnesses like Claude and Codex.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system provides Hermes Agent with a design and prototyping toolkit supported by a dedicated CLI. It enables the generation of visual exports including HTML, PDF, and MP4 based on a structured brand design system.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee functions as a persistent long-term memory layer that allows agents to maintain context across multiple sessions. It transforms diverse data formats into self-hosted knowledge graphs accessible via Rust and TypeScript clients.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library equips agents with over 800 structured cybersecurity skills mapped to industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. The collection is compatible with more than 26 AI platforms to support standardized security operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the generation of editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions or Mermaid text. It features 11 diagram presets and includes autonomous self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure diagram accuracy.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This project establishes a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce by integrating ERC-7710 permissions and x402 payments. It provides a unified skill for adjudication, escrow, and dispute resolution to connect fragmented ecosystem layers.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Compatible with Hermes and Claude Code, this tool audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI patterns. It utilizes a two-pass detection process and a 112-entry word replacement table to refine agent-generated text.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw automates the collective evolution of agent capabilities by deduplicating and improving skills across sessions. It synchronizes skill libraries across multiple devices and team environments for platforms like Hermes and Codex.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library provides spec-conformant plugins and 12 metaskills designed to preserve state within a local directory. It is built for compatibility with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This repository offers a collection of 1,099 professional skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It includes ready-to-paste exports to facilitate the use of these professional capabilities across other AI assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: Powered by TranscriptAPI, this skill set allows Hermes Agent to perform YouTube searches and retrieve data from transcripts, channels, and playlists. It follows the standard Agent Skills format for broad compatibility with coding environments.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation, allowing users to manage new skills via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions and analytical lenses for specific tasks. It reports findings alongside an analysis of potential blind spots to improve the agent's self-evaluation.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It utilizes progressive disclosure to maintain prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow skill converts rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It features Lite and Full modes for varying project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the original documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro provides a harness for long-running agents using a three-level work model and structured memory via file-backed or SQLite cards. It facilitates cross-feature learning and includes a CLI for managing tasks and card-based memory.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This project provides interoperable skills for interacting with oracle networks and smart contracts, including CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. It follows the Agent Skills specification and includes specialized support for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource offers installation guides and skills in the SKILL.md format specifically for Portuguese-speaking users. It adheres to the agentskills.io standard to ensure compatibility with the broader Hermes ecosystem.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration and prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 image generation models. The suite also includes six specialized skills for FLUX 3 video generation tasks.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned, agentskills.io-compliant skills. It supports Node.js and Python environments while providing provenance through file and line number citations.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It includes a Python client, a CLI, and commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It features built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures to allow for safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project introduces a workflow language for AI that uses a single file and four verbs to define intent as code. It supports local-first execution with any LLM and provides static auditing alongside tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during skill discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This retrieval system employs a five-layer approach, including hard triggers and semantic embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. It reduces token consumption and features graceful degradation if specific embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review tool uses parallel subagents to identify edge cases and exploits, which are then verified through sandbox execution. It integrates deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit to triage findings as verified or refuted.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project allows an agent to manage system design while the user completes tasks via a tap-based interface. It stores data locally using SQLite and connects to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub implements the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification to provide community skill browsing and one-click installation. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and features federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram while tailoring outputs to specific model families. It preserves non-English prompts through specialized heuristics and tracks token savings in a local database.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This adaptation implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates to prevent early-stop errors. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python engine for persistent task state management.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and automatically registers common skill directories.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill utilizes three parallel agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code across multiple languages. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for changes.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation based on real-world CVEs. it integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to support comprehensive security workflows.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables terminal or AI agent access to a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It integrates with clients like Hermes to provide direct installation commands for discovered plugins and tools.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal provides a quality seal by testing the structure, functionality, and security of agent skills within isolated Docker environments. It generates cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates to prove a skill actually works as intended.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This generator produces multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates for Hermes Agent. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and provides structured action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized utilities for video-to-text transcription, local OCR for privacy-focused document processing, and AI-driven text refinement. It also includes an e-commerce studio for batch material generation featuring brand overlays.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set manages deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures Hermes Agent can correctly identify and utilize existing project-compatible runtimes without new installations.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, and their associated development tools. It supports a variety of licensing models, including MIT, Apache-2.0, and unfree licenses, for integration into Nix-based environments.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct access to smartphone hardware and user interface elements.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line Termux command to install Hermes Agent on Android devices with support for over 200 AI models. It includes a gateway service to manage incoming connections directly from the mobile environment.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, featuring a configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android (via Termux) and iOS (via iSH) platforms. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web searches and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows for persistent state through mounted home directories and enables users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible, declarative configuration of Hermes Agent settings and workspace documents. It supports a hybrid skill management system and integrates secure secrets handling via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides monitoring tools for per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps, accessible via REST API, CLI, or MCP server.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple Hermes Agent instances, each with distinct identities and workspaces. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI client integrations.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project enables headless, production-ready deployments on Ubuntu and Debian servers by configuring Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It supports autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable production package that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry writes. It bundles Python 3.12 and rescue tools, offering Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments for offline use.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes specialized agents for technical, sentiment, news, fundamental, and analysis tasks within a financial trading context. It supports multiple LLM providers and employs a researcher team to assess insights through structured debates.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend via a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, or REST API. It supports frameworks such as CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It offers optional sandboxing through Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for registry management, security auditing, and VPS setup.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework utilizes a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale agents into automated teams. It features bundled skills for backup management, security auditing, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms using multiple model providers and MCP tool integration. It features durable agent memory and visual org charts for delegating agent teams.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system provides a Kanban board and review queues to supervise and review autonomous Hermes Agent work. It features live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This framework coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents to manage automated task lifecycles. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates evaluations for TerminalBench-2 and TBLite while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for tool-calling and task routing without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph designed to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It runs 100% locally on Windows, macOS, and Linux and includes an auto-sync feature.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes. It features a CLI interface and a 3D visualization dashboard, with support for data submission to public profiles.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows for the inspection of coding-agent API traffic from Hermes Agent and other tools. It provides a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions and redacts common authentication headers during recording.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates with Hermes Agent.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and historical usage trends across 30+ AI coding tools.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to assist in building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows for autonomous execution on laptops or VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers community-driven CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can customize banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using YAML-based configuration.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively within Claude Code without requiring OAuth or separate processes.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable handles and Solana-based payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP. It supports various AI providers and includes a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows and undo functionality for agent changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides integrations for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph, including memory tools for Slack, Telegram, and VS Code. It also offers a plugin for Claude Code featuring automatic context recall.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through specialized CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and local skills. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of hermes-agent and over 12 supporting services to deploy a stack in minutes. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter evaluates AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It identifies inconsistent schemas, overlapping tool descriptions, and missing stop conditions via local execution, GitHub Actions, or pre-commit hooks.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps existing configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing to monitor and auto-recover multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files for config-aware baselines.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant provides offline, local interaction with no API keys or accounts required. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, featuring adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides a single interface to manage Hermes Agent alongside other agentic tools like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local cowork application that enables 24/7 scheduled automation via Cron and includes 21 built-in assistants for creating Office documents. It supports remote access through a WebUI, Telegram, and other messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A web-based interface built with Python and vanilla JS for accessing Hermes Agent via browser or SSH tunnel. It features workspace file browsing with inline previews for use on computers or mobile devices.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard featuring visual workflow building, Kanban boards, and usage analytics. It supports streaming responses with tool traces and configuration for 10 platform channels, including Discord and Slack.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a PTY terminal, Monaco editor, and a memory browser. It implements Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, alongside an MCP catalog.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace available as a desktop app, Docker container, or standalone server. It aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents, offering native clients for iOS and Android.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native macOS workspace that provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for system repair and native views for Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust that includes the Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local execution. It features native file dialogs and rendering support for LaTeX and Mermaid.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension that links active browser context to local, cloud, or remote Hermes gateways. It includes Hermes Assist for site-aware drafting across 31 writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI application for iOS 18+ that pairs with a hermes-webui server. It allows users to manage agent tasks, sessions, and skills while providing read-only access to analytics and memory.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop workspace providing one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage with live monitoring of code diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard offers a comprehensive management suite featuring a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health. It distinguishes itself with an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles and real-time tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that provides a local-only cockpit for tracking live quota burn and analytics across eleven agent sources. It functions as a privacy-focused tool for searching transcripts and monitoring limits without telemetry or history uploads.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It is unique for its integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based mission control. It features a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This project provides a terminal user interface (TUI) and dashboard built with OpenTUI for managing Hermes sessions and profiles. It includes a kanban board specifically designed for agentic work and task management.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It secures interactions using dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication for Telegram validation.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows desktop solution requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to provide a GUI with over 100 tools. It features a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers while supporting both cloud and local model connections.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that combines real-time log streaming with a task tracking dashboard. It allows users to manage skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers through a self-hosted assistant environment.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code alongside read-only environment variable monitoring.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that utilizes tool approval cards and SSE streaming for runtime control. It features an integrated marketplace for discovering MCP servers and isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client enables orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It includes a Visual Skill Store offering over 50 curated one-click installations and supports rapid model switching.
